This is a demonstration copy of Harbour CRM, and it stores everything in your browser's memory only. Reloading the page resets all contacts, companies, deals, custom fields and settings to the original sample data, so the contacts you entered were cleared when you refreshed. Nothing you enter is sent anywhere, so they can't be recovered.

To avoid losing work next time:
1. Don't reload the page while you're working.
2. Before reloading, go to **Contacts** and select **Export CSV** to save a copy. The file includes each contact's name, email, phone, job title, company, status and custom fields.
